title: Visual Frame & Composition Study — Direct Capture
metaTitle: Visual Frame & Composition Study | Frame Feature
metaDescription: Direct visual storytelling experiment exploring depth of field, framing, and light contrast.
summary: Direct visual storytelling experiment exploring depth of field, natural optics, and light contrast.
idea: How can intentional composition and framing isolate the core subject while utilizing negative space to evoke emotion?

process.method: Captured with precise framing, controlling optical depth and natural light falloff before grading.

output: A centerpiece visual frame documenting composition clarity and texture.

learning.whatWorked: Tight geometric framing and natural light direction created immediate visual hierarchy.
learning.whatDidnt: Excess ambient light flattened contrast; controlled exposure gave much richer depth.

title: Cinematic Framing & Synthetic Lighting Study
metaTitle: Cinematic Framing & Synthetic Lighting Study | Frame Feature
metaDescription: Exploring how anamorphic lens flares and chiaroscuro lighting can be controlled with precision prompting and color grading workflows.
summary: Exploring how anamorphic lens flares and chiaroscuro lighting can be controlled with precision prompting.
idea: Can generative AI replicate the deliberate, subtle imperfection of vintage anamorphic glass without looking overly digital?

process.method: Trained a specialized contrast curve weights workflow and passed outputs through standard cinematic post-production LUTs.

output: A 12-frame visual editorial examining nocturnal architecture with orange sodium-vapor and tungsten rim lighting.

learning.whatWorked: Using specific focal lengths (e.g. 50mm f/1.2) in prompt structure anchored depth of field much better than generic 'cinematic' keywords.
learning.whatDidnt: Over-weighting film grain in the generator caused artifacts; applying 35mm grain in DaVinci post gave 10x better results.

title: Deconstructing Complex AI Concepts into Visual Micro-Frames
metaTitle: Visual Micro-Frames & Concept Clarity Case Study | Frame Feature
metaDescription: Transforming dense 20-page research papers into 3-frame carousel breakdowns that take 15 seconds to understand.
summary: Transforming 20-page research papers into 3-frame carousel breakdowns that take 15 seconds to understand.
idea: Why do people drop off from reading tech papers? Because the cognitive load is too high. Can we turn abstract ideas into intuitive visual mental models?

process.method: Distilled technical papers down to 1 core metaphor per frame, using color-coded spatial arrows and minimalist typography.

output: 5 visual breakdowns on Neural Attention, Latent Space Traversal, and Edge Compute that generated 140k+ impressions.

learning.whatWorked: Removing 60% of the text and relying on a single geometric relationship made retention skyrocket.
learning.whatDidnt: Decorative 3D illustrations distracted from comprehension; flat high-contrast 2D diagrams performed best.

title: 35mm Mechanical Frames × AI Inpainting
metaTitle: 35mm Analog Frames × Generative Inpainting | Frame Feature
metaDescription: Capturing real-world street frames on film, then extending environments using generative diffusion.
summary: Capturing real-world street frames on film, then extending environments using generative diffusion.
idea: Exploring the boundary where physical optics end and synthetic digital continuation begins.

process.method: Shot high-contrast architectural street scenes on Kodak Tri-X 400, scanned at 4800dpi, and outpainted surreal architectural geometry into the negative space.

output: A hybrid physical-digital photo series exploring urban isolation.

learning.whatWorked: The organic film grain acted as a natural noise texture that blended seamlessly with diffusion outpainting.
learning.whatDidnt: Automated prompts tended to invent modern objects; careful negative prompting was needed to preserve the timeless aesthetic.
